name: +1 Stone Skipping
desc:
🌊 Skip stones across the water, level up, and throw farther in +1 Skipping Stones!

⚡ Every bounce gives you +1 Skill!
💪 Train and level up to throw farther!
🏆 Reach farther zones to earn more Wins!
🍩 Unlock better stones and unusual objects to throw... even a DONUT!
🐾 Collect pets for powerful boosts!
🔄 Rebirth to grow stronger and beat your longest throw!

👍 Like & Favorite if you enjoy the game!
